text:
Platinum Price in 2017
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2017, the LBMA platinum price fell 6.7% between 2017-01-31 ($991) and 2017-12-28 ($925). The highest sampled price was $1,029 in February and the lowest was $915 in October. The mean of these observations was $950. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
